invariant: S-I1: no DSH session access may occur through an Attempt Preview before that Attempt has been verified against its canonical project history
gateOrder: 1. read the canonical Work events for the configured project
2. require exactly one ATTEMPT_CREATED with entity_id === attemptId
4. require the canonical Work record to exist and not contradict the creation event
5. only then examine any claimed session or host record

refusals.ATTEMPT_NOT_FOUND: no canonical ATTEMPT_CREATED names the attempt in this project
refusals.FOREIGN_ATTEMPT: the attempt exists under a different project id
refusals.ATTEMPT_SOURCE_CONFLICT: the canonical Work record contradicts its own creation event or is unreadable
refusals.HOST_RECORD_CONFLICT: a supplied host record names a different attempt

S1-A2_A5_foreignAttempt.note: a Palimpsest controller is scoped to one project, so a foreign attempt is invisible through this route; the FOREIGN_ATTEMPT branch is a defensive distinction for a multi-project store

noLabelFallback: the gate never consults a display label, a task title or a substring match
noSecondStateMachine: the gate uses the Work owner's own attempt record and event parser; no new Work state machine was implemented
